description: Find live UK vacancies on Totaljobs by keyword and area, browse a whole area, or scrape specific Totaljobs URLs. Optional filters: date posted, work from home, job type, sort order and salary band.

includeDetails.description: Fetch full descriptions, exact posting and expiry dates, parsed salary bands, company details, map coordinates and apply links. Turn off for a faster, lighter listing-only run.
includeDetails.title: Open each job page

jobType.description: Employment type as classified by Totaljobs. Leave empty for all types.
enumTitles: Full-time (legacy — no longer a Totaljobs filter, ignored)
Internship (legacy — no longer a Totaljobs filter, ignored)
Apprenticeship (legacy — no longer a Totaljobs filter, ignored)
jobType.title: Job type

keywords.description: Job titles or search terms, e.g. `software developer` or `registered nurse`. Each keyword is searched separately. (mode=search)
keywords.title: Keywords

location.description: UK town, city, county or postcode, e.g. `London`, `Manchester`, `Edinburgh`, `SW1A`. Leave empty to search the whole UK by keyword.
location.title: Location

maxItems.description: Maximum number of jobs to save. Totaljobs returns at most 100 jobs per search query; above that the actor automatically splits the search by area and filters to reach more.
maxItems.title: Max jobs

mode.description: Choose what to scrape. The last three values are aliases kept for tasks saved before the revamp.
enumTitles: Search jobs by keyword and area
Browse every job in an area
Browse every job in an area (legacy alias)
Search with a salary band (legacy alias)
mode.title: Mode

onlyNewJobs.description: Return only jobs that were not present in the previous run of this same search. The first run returns everything and seeds the baseline.
onlyNewJobs.title: Only new jobs

postedWithin.description: Only include jobs posted within this window. Leave empty for any date.
postedWithin.title: Date posted

salaryMax.description: Only keep jobs whose advertised pay starts at or below this annual amount. Hourly and daily rates are converted to a yearly figure.
salaryMax.title: Maximum salary (£/year)

salaryMin.description: Only keep jobs whose advertised pay reaches this annual amount. Hourly and daily rates are converted to a yearly figure. Jobs without a published salary are skipped when a salary filter is set.
salaryMin.title: Minimum salary (£/year)

urls.description: Search pages, company job pages or individual job pages. You can mix them. (mode=byUrls)
urls.title: Totaljobs URLs

workFromHome.description: Include only home-working roles, or exclude them. Leave empty for both.
workFromHome.title: Work from home

title: Totaljobs UK Vacancy Finder Input
